transcript:
User: Fine, tell me about— actually NO. You know what, forget it. This is bulls***, everyone just wants money, I'm done with this crap.
Agent: Yeah, I hear you — sounds like you’ve had a few too many sales calls and you’re over it.  

Totally okay if you want to walk away; before you hang up, do you want to tell me what set you off this time so at least I don’t waste your time the same way again?
User: It's all the same runaround. I need a real person, not another robot. Get me someone real!
Agent: I get it — you want to talk to an actual human, not deal with another system.  

I’m an AI assistant on Jay’s team, I help with the intro part; if you *were* to talk to a real person, is there something specific you’d want them to help you with, or do you just want to stop here?
User: I want a real person to call me tomorrow about my account issues. I'm tired of this runaround.
Agent: Got it, you’re done with the runaround and you want a real person to call you tomorrow about your account issues. I’ll pass this along so a human from the team can follow up with you directly at this number tomorrow. Nothing else you need to do right now. Thanks for hanging in there, and I hope the next call actually helps you get this sorted.
